tasks.label: Build Descent SlikeNet
args: export PATH=/c/Programs/msys64/mingw64/bin:$PATH; cmake -G Ninja -B build; status=$?; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then exit $status; fi; cmake --build build -- -j10; status=$?; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then exit $status; fi; if [ -f build/main/d2x-redux.exe ]; then cp -v build/main/d2x-redux.exe /c/Games/D2x/d2x-redux.exe; for dll in SDL.dll physfs.dll SDL_mixer.dll zlib1.dll zlibd1.dll glew32.dll glew32d.dll libpng16.dll libpng16d.dll libgcc_s_seh-1.dll libstdc++-6.dll libwinpthread-1.dll; do if [ -f build/main/$dll ]; then cp -v build/main/$dll /c/Games/D2x/$dll; fi; done; else echo Build completed, but no expected executable was found. >&2; exit 1; fi

tasks.label: Reconfigure D2s CMake
args: del /q C:\Games\D2s\build\CMakeCache.txt && rmdir /s /q C:\Games\D2s\build\CMakeFiles && C:\Programs\msys64\mingw64\bin\cmake.exe -G Ninja -S C:\Games\D2s -B C:\Games\D2s\build
